description: This file contains macro definitions, constants, and function declarations related to the Device Firmware Upgrade (DFU) process in a bootloader context. It defines memory addresses, command bytes, protocol details, and function prototypes for handling DFU operations.

methods.name: dfuStartLoop
methods.description: Waits for the DFU command to be applied (e.g., write, read).

methods.name: dfuJumpToApp
methods.description: Jumps to the application at the specified memory address.

methods.name: getTsChannel
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the TS channel structure used in data transfer.
